title: Torso with Compact Discs
description: Frontal anthropomorphic torso rendered on gold-leaf panel anchors the upper composition, surrounded by layered paper sections in blue, green, black, and ochre. Compact discs arranged in a horizontal band bisect the lower register, above vertical white and blue stripes, with red and blue ribbon descending centrally.
composition: vertical torso figure over striped lower register
